purpose: Define deterministic failed-move event labels before any outcome analysis, economic ranking, parameter search or final-holdout access.

label_families.event_basis: Europe/Copenhagen settled daily close unless explicitly declared intraday shadow

definitions.TOUCH_ONLY: Direct price trades at or above threshold but no eligible settled close confirms acceptance.
definitions.SETTLED_ACCEPTANCE: First eligible direct settled close at or above threshold after at least one prior eligible settled close below threshold.
definitions.FAILED_ACCEPTANCE: A settled acceptance is followed by the first eligible settled close below threshold before two additional eligible closes at or above threshold.
definitions.FAILED_PERSISTENCE: After settled acceptance, any preregistered persistence checkpoint closes below threshold within the 72-hour persistence window.
definitions.REJECTION_BELOW_THRESHOLD: Threshold is touched intraday and the same eligible settlement closes below threshold.
definitions.ACCEPTANCE_AND_RETEST_HOLD: Settled acceptance is followed by a direct retest that remains at or above threshold through the 72-hour persistence checkpoint.

definitions.UPSIDE_BREAK: First eligible settled close above a preregistered upper boundary after an eligible close at or below it.
definitions.DOWNSIDE_BREAK: First eligible settled close below a preregistered lower boundary after an eligible close at or above it.
definitions.FAILED_UPSIDE_BREAK: An upside break is followed by an eligible settled close back at or below the boundary within 72 hours.
definitions.FAILED_DOWNSIDE_BREAK: A downside break is followed by an eligible settled close back at or above the boundary within 72 hours.
definitions.FAILED_RECLAIM: After a prior break, price retests the boundary but fails to produce the required settled close beyond it within the declared reclaim window.
definitions.BREAK_AND_HOLD: The break remains beyond the boundary through the 72-hour persistence checkpoint.

label_families.boundary_source_rule: Boundary must exist in a frozen Forecast Ledger, experiment contract or canonical gate before the event begins.

definitions.BREADTH_COLLAPSE: Advance ratio falls by at least 12 percentage points between comparable snapshots with identical membership hash.
definitions.BREADTH_RECOVERY: Advance ratio rises by at least 12 percentage points between comparable snapshots with identical membership hash.
definitions.PRICE_BREADTH_DIVERGENCE: Advance ratio changes by at least 12 percentage points while absolute BTC move is below 2.0 percent and absolute ETH move is below 2.5 percent over the same comparable interval.
definitions.FAILED_BREADTH_RECOVERY: A breadth recovery is followed by a decline of at least 8 percentage points within 48 hours without a membership change.

definitions.POSITIVE_TO_NEGATIVE_REVERSAL: An available settled session below zero follows at least three consecutive available positive sessions.
definitions.NEGATIVE_TO_POSITIVE_REVERSAL: An available settled session above zero follows at least three consecutive available negative sessions.
definitions.FLOW_SHOCK: Available absolute daily net flow exceeds the frozen asset-specific 95th percentile estimated only from prior available sessions.
definitions.FAILED_FLOW_CONFIRMATION: A reversal signal is not followed by a second same-sign available session within the next two eligible sessions.

label_families.blocker: Row-level publication and retrieval timestamps are not yet materialized.
